这是我的 Wan2.2 工作流程。
我仍在改进它，但如果您没有 Wan2.2 的工作流程，我认为这是一个很好的起点。我从其他人那里得到了这个工作流程，但我添加了一些不错的定制，我认为值得分享。

通常我总是使用(wan 2.2 实验) WAN 通用 NSFW洛拉斯，尽管我正在做 SFW，因为它有助于迅速遵守。或者至少它有助于 Danbooru 标签提示。

我也倾向于总是使用这个布布物理洛拉，因为它似乎给一切都增添了一点活力。

如果您刚刚开始，我建议将高度和宽度分别降低到 400，以便您可以进行试验。 1600 像素 (400*400=1600) 分辨率较低，但 2400 像素 (600*400) 会产生不错的效果。如果您有时间和显存，请将分辨率调高。 3000+ 在速度和结果之间取得了很好的平衡。

PS，如果您使用 Windows，您可能需要反转我在创建文件路径的节点中使用的所有“/”。 （此外，您应该考虑在 Windows 11 开始记录您所做的一切之前删除该间谍软件˙\_(ツ)_/˙)

PPS 归功于 Olivio Sarikas 和这个Youtube作为我构建的源工作流程。

o.en:
Here is my Wan2.2 Workflow.
I'm still improving it but I think its a nice starting point if you don't have a working workflow for Wan2.2. I got this workflow from someone else but I added some nice customization that I think make it worth sharing.

As a rule I always use(wan 2.2 experimental) WAN General NSFWLoras even though I'm making SFW, because it helps with prompt adherence. Or at least it helps with Danbooru tag prompting.

Also I tend to always use thisBoob PhysicsLora because it seems to add a bit of bounce to everything.

If you are just getting started I recommend lowering the height and width to 400 each so you can experiment. 1600 pixels (400*400=1600) is lowres but 2400 pixels (600*400) produces nice results. Push the resolution higher if you have time and VRAM. 3000+ is a pretty good balance between speed and results.

PS if you use Windows you will probably need to reverse all the "/" I used in the nodes that make the file paths. (Also you should consider dropping that spyware before Windows 11 starts literally recording everything you are doing

PPS Credit to Olivio Sarikas and thisYoutubeas the source workflow that I built on.
